sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Shawbury United on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their position at the top. Sandbach have won their most recent league match and sit on 34 points from 16 games, though they did suffer two losses earlier in their recent run. Shawbury arrive on the back of two straight wins but remain in 11th place with a -10 goal difference.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 34 points, face a critical test against Sandbach's title rivals—though notably the two leaders play different opponents this week. Wolves host no fixture listed here but their six-game winning streak keeps them in the hunt. In the battle for mid-table, AFC Bridgnorth (5th, 30pts) entertain Wednesfield Community (16th, 16pts) on Saturday; Eccleshall (3rd, 31pts) are not in action this week. Stafford Town (6th, 29pts) travel to Market Drayton Town (14th, 17pts) in a Saturday fixture where the away side will be favored. Crewe (17th, 15pts) face Cheadle Heath Nomads (12th, 19pts), Alsager Town (18th, 11pts) host New Mills (10th, 21pts) and then travel to Barnton (8th, 25pts) on Tuesday—a tough double for the struggling hosts. Widnes Town (20th, 8pts) visit Brereton Social (13th, 18pts), and Sandbach's other Saturday opponent Shawbury also plays Foley Meir (15th) in Foley's home match against Foley Meir.
